newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Fangda to issue 30 mln new B share.
newsitem.headline: China Fangda to issue 30 mln new B share.

text.p: Shenzhen Fangda Industrial Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would offer and list 30 million new foreign currency B shares by June 20 this year to try to raise 260 million yuan.

The building materials maker has priced the shares at HK$8.50 each and expects to raise about 260 million yuan in net proceeds from the offer, a company statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said.
On Wednesday morning, the company's B shares opened at HK$12.47.

Fangda would use funds from the issue to make technological improvements, boost output and help cash flow, the statement said. The China Securities Regulatory Commission, the bourse watchdog, had approved the issue, it added.
Holders of the new B shares will be entitled to the full 1997 dividend, it said.
Fangda posted net profits of 107.9 million yuan for 1996 based on international accounting standards, compared to 42.05 million yuan in 1995. It attributed the growth to increased sales.
Major China brokerage, Shenyin & Wanguo Securities recently recommended Fangda's B shares as a "buy", saying Fangda was set to expand strongly in the next two years.
The brokerage said in a research paper that Fangda's products, particularly curtain wall glass, were eligible for special support from the central government.

After the offer, Fangda will have a total of 240 million shares, including 100 million B shares, 28 million domestic currency A shares and 112 million unlisted shares held by the company founders, the statement said.
